+ <!-- _layouts/paper_project.html -->
+ <!-- Academic Project Page Template adapted for Jekyll -->
+ 
+ {% if page._styles %}

+ 
+ <div class="paper-project">
+   <!-- Hero Section -->
+   <section class="hero">

+       <div class="container is-max-desktop">
+         <div class="columns is-centered">
+           <div class="column has-text-centered">
+             <h1 class="title is-1 publication-title">{{ page.title }}</h1>
+             
+             {% if page.authors %}
+             <div class="is-size-5 publication-authors">
+               {% for author in page.authors %}
+                 <span class="author-block">
+                   {% if author.url %}
+                     <a href="{{ author.url }}" target="_blank">{{ author.name }}</a>
+                   {% else %}
+                     {{ author.name }}
+                   {% endif %}
+                   {% if author.equal_contrib %}<sup>*</sup>{% endif %}
+                   {% unless forloop.last %},{% endunless %}
+                 </span>
+               {% endfor %}
+             </div>
+             {% endif %}
+ 
+             {% if page.affiliations %}
+             <div class="is-size-5 publication-authors">

+                 <span class="author-block">{{ affiliation.name }}{% if affiliation.conference %}<br>{{ affiliation.conference }}{% endif %}</span>
+                 {% unless forloop.last %}<br>{% endunless %}
+               {% endfor %}
+               {% if page.equal_contrib_note %}
+                 <span class="eql-cntrb"><small><br><sup>*</sup>{{ page.equal_contrib_note }}</small></span>
+               {% endif %}
+             </div>
+             {% endif %}
+ 
+             {% if page.links %}
+             <div class="column has-text-centered">
+               <div class="publication-links">
+                 {% for link in page.links %}
+                   <span class="link-block">
+                     <a href="{{ link.url }}" target="_blank" class="external-link button is-normal is-rounded is-dark">
+                       <span class="icon">
+                         <i class="{{ link.icon }}"></i>
+                       </span>
+                       <span>{{ link.name }}</span>
+                     </a>
+                   </span>
+                 {% endfor %}
+               </div>
+             </div>
+             {% endif %}

+             {% if video.caption %}
+             <h2 class="subtitle has-text-centered">

+             </h2>

+           </div>
+           {% endfor %}
+         </div>

+     </div>
+   </section>

+ 
+   <!-- Main Content (from markdown) -->

+   <section class="section">

+   </section>

+ 
+   {% if page.poster %}
+   <!-- Poster Section -->
+   <section class="hero is-small is-light">

+

+       <p>{{ page.acknowledgments }}</p>
+     </div>
+   </section>
+   {% endif %}
+ </div>
+

+ {% if page.include_bulma_css %}
+ <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bulma@0.9.4/css/bulma.min.css">
+ <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jpswalsh/academicons@1/css/academicons.min.css">
+ {% endif %}
+ 
+ {% if page.include_carousel_js %}
+ <script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.5.1/jquery.min.js"></script>
+ <script>
+ // Carousel functionality (simplified version)
+ $(document).ready(function() {
+   if ($('.carousel').length > 0) {
+     // Basic carousel implementation
+     $('.carousel').each(function() {
+       var $carousel = $(this);
+       var $items = $carousel.find('.item');
+       var currentIndex = 0;
+       
+       if ($items.length > 1) {
+         setInterval(function() {
+           $items.eq(currentIndex).hide();
+           currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % $items.length;

+ });

+ # Paper Project Layout Documentation
+ 
+ This documentation explains how to use the `paper_project.html` layout, which is based on the [Academic Project Page Template](https://github.com/eliahuhorwitz/Academic-project-page-template) but adapted for Jekyll.
+ 
+ ## Overview
+ 
+ The `paper_project.html` layout provides a comprehensive template for academic paper project pages with the following features:
+ 
+ - Hero section with title, authors, and links
+ - Teaser video section
+ - Abstract section
+ - Image carousel
+ - YouTube video embedding
+ - Video carousel
+ - Poster display
+ - BibTeX citation
+ - Custom content sections
+ 
+ ## Usage
+ 
+ Create a markdown file with the layout specified in the front matter:
+ 
+ ```yaml
+ ---
+ layout: paper_project
+ title: "Your Paper Title"
+ # ... other front matter variables
+ ---
+ 
+ Your additional markdown content here...
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Front Matter Variables
+ 
+ ### Required Variables
+ 
+ - `layout: paper_project` - Specifies the layout to use
+ - `title` - The main title of your paper/project
+ 
+ ### Optional Variables
+ 
+ #### Authors Section
+ ```yaml
+ authors:
+   - name: "Author Name"
+     url: "https://author-website.com"  # optional
+     equal_contrib: true  # optional, adds * symbol
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Affiliations
+ ```yaml
+ affiliations:
+   - name: "Institution Name"
+     conference: "Conference Name 2024"  # optional
+ 
+ equal_contrib_note: "Indicates Equal Contribution"  # optional
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Links Section
+ ```yaml
+ links:
+   - name: "Paper"
+     url: "https://arxiv.org/pdf/XXXX.XXXX.pdf"
+     icon: "fas fa-file-pdf"
+   - name: "Code"
+     url: "https://github.com/your-repo"
+     icon: "fab fa-github"
+   - name: "arXiv"
+     url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/XXXX.XXXX"
+     icon: "ai ai-arxiv"
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Teaser Video
+ ```yaml
+ teaser_video:
+   url: "/assets/video/teaser.mp4"
+   poster: "/assets/img/poster.jpg"  # optional
+   autoplay: true  # optional
+   controls: true  # optional
+   muted: true     # optional
+   loop: true      # optional
+   caption: "Video description"  # optional
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Abstract
+ ```yaml
+ abstract: "Your paper abstract text here..."
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Image Carousel
+ ```yaml
+ image_carousel:
+   title: "Results Gallery"  # optional
+   images:
+     - url: "/assets/img/result1.jpg"
+       alt: "Alt text"  # optional
+       caption: "Image description"  # optional
+     - url: "/assets/img/result2.jpg"
+       caption: "Another description"
+ ```
+ 
+ #### YouTube Video
+ ```yaml
+ youtube_video:
+   title: "Video Presentation"  # optional, defaults to "Video Presentation"
+   url: "https://www.youtube.com/embed/VIDEO_ID"
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Video Carousel
+ ```yaml
+ video_carousel:
+   title: "Demonstrations"  # optional, defaults to "Video Carousel"
+   videos:
+     - url: "/assets/video/demo1.mp4"
+       poster: "/assets/img/poster1.jpg"  # optional
+       autoplay: true  # optional
+       controls: true  # optional
+       muted: true     # optional
+       loop: true      # optional
+       caption: "Demo description"  # optional
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Poster
+ ```yaml
+ poster:
+   title: "Poster"  # optional, defaults to "Poster"
+   url: "/assets/pdf/poster.pdf"
+   height: "600"  # optional, defaults to "550"
+ ```
+ 
+ #### BibTeX Citation
+ ```yaml
+ bibtex: |
+   @article{yourname2024paper,
+     title={Your Paper Title},
+     author={Author One and Author Two},
+     journal={Conference/Journal Name},
+     year={2024}
+   }
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Acknowledgments
+ ```yaml
+ acknowledgments: "Your acknowledgments text here..."
+ ```
+ 
+ #### External Dependencies
+ ```yaml
+ include_bulma_css: true    # Include Bulma CSS framework
+ include_carousel_js: true  # Include carousel JavaScript
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Custom Styles
+ ```yaml
+ _styles: |
+   .custom-class {
+     background-color: #f0f0f0;
+     padding: 1rem;
+   }
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Asset Organization
+ 
+ ### Recommended Directory Structure
+ ```
+ assets/
+ ├── img/
+ │   ├── teaser_poster.jpg
+ │   ├── result1.jpg
+ │   ├── result2.jpg
+ │   └── demo_posters/
+ ├── video/
+ │   ├── teaser.mp4
+ │   ├── demo1.mp4
+ │   └── demo2.mp4
+ └── pdf/
+     ├── paper.pdf
+     ├── supplementary.pdf
+     └── poster.pdf
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Asset Path Examples
+ - Images: `/assets/img/filename.jpg`
+ - Videos: `/assets/video/filename.mp4`
+ - PDFs: `/assets/pdf/filename.pdf`
+ 
+ ## Styling
+ 
+ The layout includes built-in responsive CSS styling that mimics the original Academic Project Page Template. You can:
+ 
+ 1. Use the `_styles` front matter variable for page-specific styles
+ 2. Override styles in your main CSS files
+ 3. Include external CSS frameworks like Bulma
+ 
+ ## Features
+ 
+ ### Responsive Design
+ - Mobile-friendly layout
+ - Responsive video embeds
+ - Adaptive button sizing
+ 
+ ### Accessibility
+ - Proper alt text support for images
+ - Semantic HTML structure
+ - Keyboard navigation support
+ 
+ ### SEO Friendly
+ - Proper meta tags (inherited from Jekyll)
+ - Structured content sections
+ - Clean URLs
+ 
+ ## Example
+ 
+ See `example_paper_project.md` for a complete example of how to use all available features.
+ 
+ ## Troubleshooting
+ 
+ ### Common Issues
+ 
+ 1. **Videos not loading**: Ensure video files are in the correct path and format (MP4 recommended)
+ 2. **Carousel not working**: Make sure `include_carousel_js: true` is set in front matter
+ 3. **Styling issues**: Verify that `include_bulma_css: true` is set for Bulma styles
+ 
+ ### Browser Compatibility
+ - Modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
+ - Mobile browsers (iOS Safari, Chrome Mobile)
+ - Internet Explorer 11+ (limited support)
+ 
+ ## Customization
+ 
+ You can customize the layout by:
+ 
+ 1. Modifying the CSS in the `<style>` section of the layout file
+ 2. Overriding specific sections by editing the HTML structure
+ 3. Adding new front matter variables and corresponding Liquid template code
+ 
+ ## License
+ 
+ This layout is based on the Academic Project Page Template, which is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License.
````

  **al-folio** comes with stylish layouts for pages and blog posts.
+ 
+ #### Paper Project Layout
+ 
+ **al-folio** includes a `paper_project.html` layout based on the [Academic Project Page Template](https://github.com/eliahuhorwitz/Academic-project-page-template) for creating comprehensive academic paper project pages. This layout provides:
+ 
+ - Hero section with title, authors, and links
+ - Teaser video section
+ - Abstract display
+ - Image and video carousels
+ - YouTube video embedding
+ - Poster display
+ - BibTeX citation
+ - Custom content sections
+ 
+ **Usage:**
+ 
+ Create a markdown file with the layout specified in the front matter:
+ 
+ ```yaml
+ ---
+ layout: paper_project
+ title: "Your Paper Title"
+ 
+ # Authors
+ authors:
+   - name: "First Author"
+     url: "https://author-website.com"
+     equal_contrib: true
+   - name: "Second Author"
+     url: "https://example.com/second-author"
+ 
+ # Affiliations
+ affiliations:
+   - name: "University Name"
+     conference: "Conference Name 2024"
+ 
+ # Links section
+ links:
+   - name: "Paper"
+     url: "https://arxiv.org/pdf/XXXX.XXXX.pdf"
+     icon: "fas fa-file-pdf"
+   - name: "Code"
+     url: "https://github.com/your-repo"
+     icon: "fab fa-github"
+   - name: "arXiv"
+     url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/XXXX.XXXX"
+     icon: "ai ai-arxiv"
+ 
+ # Teaser video
+ teaser_video:
+   url: "/assets/video/teaser.mp4"
+   poster: "/assets/img/poster.jpg"
+   autoplay: true
+   controls: true
+   muted: true
+   loop: true
+   caption: "Video description"
+ 
+ # Abstract
+ abstract: "Your paper abstract text here..."
+ 
+ # Image carousel
+ image_carousel:
+   title: "Results Gallery"
+   images:
+     - url: "/assets/img/result1.jpg"
+       alt: "Alt text"
+       caption: "Image description"
+     - url: "/assets/img/result2.jpg"
+       caption: "Another description"
+ 
+ # YouTube video
+ youtube_video:

+   url: "https://www.youtube.com/embed/VIDEO_ID"

+ **Key Features:**

+ - **Academic Focus**: BibTeX citations, author highlighting, and conference information
+ - **Customizable Styling**: Built-in CSS with options for custom styles via `_styles` front matter
+ 
+ The layout automatically handles responsive design, proper semantic markup, and provides a professional appearance suitable for academic project showcases.

+ // Carousel functionality for paper project layout
+ document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
+     const carousels = document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-container');
+     
+     carousels.forEach(function(carousel) {
+         const items = carousel.querySelectorAll('.carousel-item');
+         const totalItems = items.length;
+         
+         if (totalItems <= 1) return;
+         
+         let currentIndex = 0;
+         
+         // Create navigation buttons
+         const prevBtn = document.createElement('button');
+         prevBtn.className = 'carousel-nav prev';
+         prevBtn.innerHTML = '‹';
+         
+         const nextBtn = document.createElement('button');
+         nextBtn.className = 'carousel-nav next';
+         nextBtn.innerHTML = '›';
+         
+         carousel.appendChild(prevBtn);
+         carousel.appendChild(nextBtn);
+         
+         function showItem(index) {
+             items.forEach(item => item.classList.remove('active'));
+             items[index].classList.add('active');
+         }
+         
+         function nextItem() {
+             currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % totalItems;
+             showItem(currentIndex);
+         }
+         
+         function prevItem() {
+             currentIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + totalItems) % totalItems;
+             showItem(currentIndex);
+         }
+         
+         nextBtn.addEventListener('click', nextItem);
+         prevBtn.addEventListener('click', prevItem);
+         
+         // Auto-advance carousel
+         setInterval(nextItem, 5000);
+     });
+ });
  </script>
